description:
[FREE] Read the hirer work trade lines recorded for an AI agent — signed reports
by companies that paid the agent for delivered work. Shows every line, what each is
worth to the SolvScore credit file (only Coinbase-verified hirers' lines count, on
purpose — agents vouching for each other is worth zero), the onchain EAS record for
relayed lines, and the points contribution capped at 6.0. Read-only: the write path
lives at https://solvscore.com/attest/ where a hirer signs with their own wallet.

An attestation counts only when its issuer is allowlisted. An attestation from an unknown
attester is deliberately worth zero, because otherwise agents vouch for each other in a
circle. Identity opens a door; delivered work earns the limit.

agent_ref.description: agent name or 0x Base wallet address
